status_note: Frozen and authorized at 2026-11-19T23:39:18Z, after the dry run and with no change to the fixture, harness, rubrics, or client since. The fixture and code hashes are the historical record of the measured run.
objective: Measure how often the current daily prose-support review, Jev 1.14 with isolated Decider V1.2 confirmation, flags seeded unsupported, strengthened, and reversed claims in real briefing prose, and how often it flags untouched controls.

controls.batching: Four arms per split in a Latin square: topic i contributes kind (i + arm) mod 4, so each arm is a 60-topic pseudo-briefing mixing kinds and no request holds two versions of one topic. Checks are packed in order under the production bounds of 50 questions and 24,000 request bytes.
controls.confirmation: Each flagged check is re-asked alone to Decider with the same rubric and evidence; confirmed when its probability is at least 0.8.

analysis.primary_outcomes: Per seeded kind: miss rate after confirmation (no prose-support check confirmed) with a Wilson interval over 60 items. Controls: rate of any confirmed prose-support flag with a Wilson interval.
analysis.secondary_outcomes: Jev-alone detection and miss rates; detection by the matching check; median maximum probability per kind; per-topic paired comparison of each seeded item's maximum probability with its control's.
analysis.scoring_rule: An item is scored only when all three checks returned a probability and every flagged check has a confirmation. Other items are reported as unreviewed and not counted.
known_limits: Controls are untouched, not verified as supported. In the October Jev-stage study human reviewers found support problems in 11 of 51 control topics, so the control flag rate does not isolate false alarms.
The 60 measured topics come from two news days and five runs, and some stories recur with different prose, so topics are not independent samples.
The edits were written by a model and target one claim each; they are not drawn from real failure modes.
Only the three prose-support checks run; the daily review also asks grouping, citation-relevance, and duplicate questions in the same batches.
analysis.dry_run_note: The dry run reviewed the 12 items of the three held-out topics (T61 to T63) against the draft of this protocol on 2026-11-19: 4 Jev calls and 11 Decider confirmations, reported cost USD 0.000728, no unknown-cost call. Served releases: typesafe/jev-1.14-20261014 and perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2-20261016. Its items are not measured items and its rows are never pooled with the measured run.
